notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Dear Players!

Although, we weren’t very vocal about what’s going on behind the scenes, there is a lot happening in Gamebook H. P. Lovecraft: The Haunter of the Dark!
Thank you for all the reviews as we have taken them into consideration, while focusing on our production. 

Therefore, what’s coming in a few months’ time will be even better and more polished gamebook.
It will be our most ambitious project and we highly encourage you to [b]add it to your wishlist and to follow us on Steam and Twitter[/b] to stay updated.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2126950/Gamebook_H_P_Lovecraft_The_Haunter_of_the_Dark/
https://twitter.com/MidworldOrg

Take care and stay tuned!
